# Probe rows for #538 (PR #539): a short subscript flag argument with a `[`
# no later `]` of the word closes. Regenerate the grid with
#     zsh-lint-probe -rows internal/probe/testdata/rows-538.txt -out DIR
# One row per line: head x part x part x context, where the head is (r) or (i),
# each part is one of a, [, ], [a], a[b]c, [!a], [[:alpha:]], '[', "[", \[,
# \], ${y}, $y[1], (a|[b]), (a[), b, " c", ;c, |c, "c", <1-2>, ${y:-]},
# $(echo ]), `echo ]`, "]", ']', \]] (the second part may be empty), and the
# context is print $x[S], print "$x[S]", x=$x[S], [[ $x[S] == a ]],
# print $(print $x[S]) or print $x[S,2]. Rows are sorted and unique.

# verdicts PR #539 reported (#545).
